messages:
nina: Quick check — opened a TF PR to switch ExternalSecret behavior from replace -> rehydrate for svc tokens. Want a sanity check before merge.

 dom: Link?

 nina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123. change in modules/externalsecrets/template.tpl + helm overlay values.

 kevin: Rehydrate = patch instead of delete/create, right? Concern is projected token mount behavior and not forcing pod restarts.

 sasha: correct. It uses strategic merge to update secret contents, avoids rotation-triggered pod restarts. Main risk is clients reading old cached files if TTL/annot isn't handled.

 nina: We ran a local smoke with projected token and did not see restarts. PR also bumps the annotation TTL to 300s.

 ops-bot: deploy-bot: last rotation for svc-account-dashboard at 2026-02-10T03:14:22Z — success

 kevin: two asks: add rollback steps in PR and a CI smoke that reads the file from the mounted volume after a simulated rotation.

 nina: Added rollback runbook in PR description and a smoke job: `scripts/ci/secret-smoke.sh` — it patches the secret and verifies file contents.

 sasha: helm values snippet in the PR:
```
externalSecrets:
  template:
    rehydrate: true
    ttl: 300
```

 dom: LGTM after CI passes. :thumbsup:

 nina: thanks — i'll merge after green and monitor secret reconcile latencies for 24h. will follow up if anything pops.

 kevin: also double-check Vault path mapping in the PR (vault kv v2 path vs v1); small mismatch bit us last time.

 nina: will add a note. tagging @kevin for a quick review of the path mapping.
